models.name: v-model
models.description:
Currently selected rows.
Requires `selectable` to be set.

props.name: rows
props.description:
The rows to be listed.
The rows will be listed in the given array order.

props.name: hover
props.description: When enabled hovering over a row will be highlighted.

props.name: expandableAttribute
props.description:
Attribute of expandable content in rows.
If provided, the table can contain expandable rows.

props.name: expandableDescribedby
props.description: Element id for aria-describedby on expandable rows to describe expanded content.

props.name: selectable
props.description:
When set the table rows will be selectable.

For multiselect, set value to `"multi"` (or `true`).
For single select, set value to `"single"`.

The current set of selected rows can be accessed with `v-model`.

The `select` and `unselect` events will be emitted when a row is selected
or deselected.

props.name: striped
props.description: When enabled alternating rows will use a different background color.

props.name: scroll
props.description:
Enable scrolling inside table.

Can be one of the following values:

- `"horizontal"`: Enables horizontal scrolling
- `"vertical"`: Does nothing (deprecated)
- `"both"`: Acts as horizontal (deprecated)
- `"none"`: Disables scrolling (default)

events.name: change
events.description:
Emitted when row is activated.

Note: This event is being emitted even if prop `showActive` is set to `false`!

events.name: select
events.description:
Emitted when row is selected. See also `unselect`.

This event is only emitted when using prop `selectable`.

events.name: unselect
events.description:
Emitted when row is unselected. See also `select`.

This event is only emitted when using prop `selectable`.

events.name: expand
events.description:
Emitted when row is expanded. See also `collapse`.

This event is only emitted when using expandable rows.

properties.name: row
properties.description: The parent row holding rows to be expanded.

events.name: collapse
events.description: Emitted when row is collapsed. See also `expand`.

properties.name: row
properties.description: The parent row holding rows to be collapsed.

slots.name: row-description
slots.description: Text to use as `aria-label` on the table row element (`<tr>`).

slots.name: checkbox-description
slots.description: Screenreader label for the checkbox when using `selectable`.

slots.name: selectable-description
slots.description: Screenreader label for selectable radio or checkbox when using `selectable`.

bindings.name: parentRow
bindings.description: The parent row of the expandable rows.

slots.name: empty
slots.description: Slot for displaying a message when table is empty.
